Every piece here is a recipe: a style plus a seed number. The same seed always rebuilds the same piece. Each batch only shows distinct shapes: colors and materials will become options later, so two pieces that differ only in color count as one. Tick Keep on the ones you like; click a picture to turn it and leave a note.

Building the home

Each card is one household's home, a small, medium or large apartment with real rooms, furnished from who lives there: their jobs, shifts, temperament and hobbies pick the beds, the kitchen, the set (A Neon tenement or B Hab module) and the mess. The home's size comes from the building; spare bedrooms become a den or hobby room. Click a pod to orbit it. Refurnish keeps the household and tries a new layout.
